extracted text: The paper studies a modified 206 aluminum alloy with high Si content (1.2%) to improve hot tearing resistance in semi-solid casting. The alloy was solution heat treated under different conditions and artificially aged at 185°C for 5h. Three different heat treatment conditions were evaluated: T7A (500°C for 12h, then quenched and aged), T7B (500°C for 6h + 515°C for 8h, then quenched and aged), and T7C (515°C for 2h + 525°C for 8h, then quenched and aged). The T7B condition was found to be optimal to avoid incipient melting while achieving the highest mechanical properties. The alloy showed primarily Al₂Cu and Al₁₅(FeMnCu)₃Si₂ intermetallic phases in the microstructure.
